locator: Subject Protocol, printed pp. 2 and 6 (PDF pp. 8 and 12)
note: Ten healthy men aged 21–35 were monitored in an ongoing study with Sonos 1000 at 29,500 ft. Reported protocol includes a 60-minute 100% oxygen prebreathe, oxygen during flight and repeated light lower-limb exercise. The planned exposure was up to four hours with early termination for DCS. The number of chamber runs and the clinical event count for the monitored group are unavailable.
